sonication and ultraviolent C light (UV-C) treatment are effective hurdle technologies for improving the quality of Chakanan mango (M. indica L.) juice, and that the combination of sonication and UVC treatment is more effective than the use of either technology alone.
the combination of sonication and UVC treatment can be used as hurdle technology in Chokanan mango juices to improve the quality and safety of mango juice.
sonication and UV–C treatment in combination with thermal processing can be used to enhance the quality and safety of mango juice.

the development and application of hurdle technology to improve quality and safety of mango juice.
the development of hurdle concept to improve the quality and safety of Chokanan juice by using sonication and UV- C treatment as a hurdle technology.
the development of hurdle concept of sonication and UVC to extend the shelf life and quality of Chokaran mango juice.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the use of hurdle concept in mango juice processing is a promising approach for the production of fresh-like mango juice.
sonication and UV combined with UV-C can be a promising hurdle technology for the production of fresh-like Chokanan mango juices.
sonication and UV combined treatment could be used as an alternative to thermal pasteurization in mango juice processing, which could improve the nutritional and sensory properties of the juice.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the combination of sonication and/or UV-C with thermal treatment could be a promising approach in the development of fresh-like mango juice with extended shelf life.
sonication and UV treatment can improve the quality of mango juice without affecting its physicochemical and microbial quality.
sonication and UV combined treatment is a promising non-thermal technology that could be used as hurdle concept for Chokanan mango juices.

the combination of sonication and low-dose UV-C irradiation is an effective non-thermal hurdle technology to extend the shelf life of Chokanan juice.

sonication combined with UV-C treatment can be a promising non-thermal processing method that can be applied in the mango juice processing industry.
